answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the onyx queue while genuine members promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 477 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the mirror. The knoll index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 378 account operation therefore ties up 32 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
